brandName: Cake-me · live test with visual follow-up

goals.northStar: Grow Cake-me into a larger cheesecake chain through new stores and franchises ('El único lugar que nos falta es el tuyo').

voice.rhythm: Short, punchy headline fragments and direct imperatives ('Pide tu tarta entera'), with a light, conversational wink ('aunque, casi todo...').
voice.register: Warm, friendly, informal and emotional. Positive, celebratory and playful, with emojis, written in Spanish.
signatures: Emotional tagline built on happiness: 'La Felicidad en cada Bocado'
Heart-first craft language: 'Cheesecake artesano, hecho con corazón'

jtbd: Get a good cheesecake slice for very little money when I want a quick sweet treat.
Order a whole cheesecake, personalized with toppings, for a birthday or celebration without a complicated process.
Share a dessert plan with friends and try several flavours without overspending.
audience.primary: Urban dessert lovers in Barcelona and Madrid, including locals, young people and groups of friends, who want an affordable, indulgent cheesecake slice or a whole cake for a celebration. Price tiers, the 'plan con amigos' offer and the whole-cake ordering CTAs point to this group.
audience.secondary: Customers with dietary needs, such as the weekend gluten-free option, and visitors who discover the shops by chance.

identity.category: Food & beverage / specialty dessert retail — cheesecake shop (by the slice and whole cakes, toppings customization, WhatsApp pre-orders, franchise offer)
identity.positioning: Cake-me is a cheesecake-focused shop chain in Barcelona and Madrid that sells accessible, customizable cheesecake by the slice (classic from 0,99€) or whole, under the tagline 'La Felicidad en cada Bocado'.

refusals: Never present Cake-me as luxury, exclusive or fine-dining; keep the tone accessible and everyday.
Do not drop the warm, heart-first voice for cold corporate language or industrial wording.
Do not claim 'el mejor cheesecake de Barcelona' or any artisan or quality superiority without independent proof.
Never publish a rating that conflicts with the Google data (4.7 from 800 reviews) without a stated source.
Do not use cold, clinical studio lighting or stiff fine-dining tableware in imagery.
Do not promise gluten-free availability beyond weekends, or state allergen safety claims the allergen sheet does not support.

watchouts: A 0,99€ hero price and 'artesano / hecho con corazón' craft claims can pull against each other: low price may undermine the artisan perception unless quality is evidenced.

Whole-cake sales depend on WhatsApp ordering with 24h notice, which can conflict with the impulse, in-store ease of the slice offer. The gluten-free option is weekend-only.

competitors.name: Jon Cake
competitors.difference: Evidence shows a whole-cake, delivery-led maker with a cheese-forward recipe (mascarpone, parmesan, Grana Padano, gorgonzola). Cake-me's evidence shows a store network with slice sales and toppings customization.
competitors.positioning: Barcelona cheesecake maker. A Barcelona Urbana guide lists whole cakes from €13 and notes that queues are part of the experience. A 2022 New Barcelona Post article describes a home-delivery business that makes six types of cheesecake and presents its cheesecake as 'crowned the best in Barcelona'. It started in a shared kitchen during lockdown.
competitors.reasonToChoose: Lowest listed whole-cake entry price in the Barcelona Urbana guide; strong press reputation and a recipe built on famous cheesecakes (per the cited articles).

competitors.name: Pasté BCN
competitors.difference: Positioned around cheese-course-style cheesecake and shipping. Cake-me's evidence emphasises low-priced slices and a customizable topping menu.
competitors.positioning: Whole cheesecakes of six to eight slices, in ten versions, priced €15–€32 per the Barcelona Urbana guide. Uses strong cheeses (manchego, gorgonzola, Blau de Joglars) and ships nationwide.
competitors.reasonToChoose: Cheese-forward flavour, a broad range of versions, and nationwide shipping.

competitors.name: Funky Bakers
competitors.difference: Defined by a specific regional style. Cake-me's supplied evidence does not state a style tradition and leads with variety and toppings.
competitors.positioning: Basque (San Sebastián) style cheesecake at Passeig del Born 10, made to the Bar La Viña recipe: caramelised outside, creamy inside, no biscuit base.
competitors.reasonToChoose: An authentic Basque-style cheesecake, best eaten freshly made.

competitors.name: Cotó Cake
competitors.difference: A different texture tradition (airy cotton). Cake-me's supplied evidence shows classic and flavoured cheesecakes, with no evidence of this style.
competitors.positioning: Japanese cotton-style cheesecake at Consell de Cent 187, served cold, warm or hot. The guide says no other house in the city offers this choice.
competitors.reasonToChoose: A light, soufflé-like texture and the choice of serving temperature.

researchGaps: Verified competitor URLs, slice prices and store counts for Jon Cake, Pasté BCN, Funky Bakers and Cotó Cake
Competitive evidence for Madrid, where Cake-me has one listed store

The 'artesano' and ingredient-quality claims have no verified basis beyond brand wording and one review

Delivery, takeaway and minimum order terms
Quantitative customer research confirming the audience
The allergen and nutrition PDF contents were not inspected

positioning.frameOfReference: Cheesecake shops and bakeries in Barcelona, where supplied research shows several distinct styles (Basque, Japanese cotton, strong-cheese bakery style) and whole-cake takeaway/delivery options.

pointsOfDifference.claim: Very low entry price at slice level: classic slice 0,99€, group plan of 4 specials plus a free classic for 11,99€.
pointsOfDifference.proof: Cake-me homepage price list and offers. Brand-stated; not independently compared.
pointsOfDifference.rationale: Supports an 'accessible indulgence' frame. The cited competitor whole-cake price (Jon Cake from €13) is close to Cake-me's classic whole cake (13,99€), so the price edge is clearest at slice level.

pointsOfDifference.claim: Build-your-own customization: sauces, jams and crunchy toppings at 0,99€ each; up to 3 toppings on a whole cake for 4,99€.
pointsOfDifference.proof: Cake-me homepage customization menu and a customer review praising topping options.
pointsOfDifference.rationale: Turns a standard product into a personalized one. Equivalent customization is not described for the competitors in the supplied research, but that absence is not proof competitors lack it.

pointsOfDifference.claim: Multi-store walk-in presence (5 Barcelona locations, 1 Madrid) open daily 11:00–22:00, plus a franchise offer.
pointsOfDifference.proof: Cake-me homepage store list and hours. Store openings are brand-stated.
pointsOfDifference.rationale: Gives an impulse, in-store slice occasion alongside whole-cake pre-orders. The supplied competitor evidence emphasises whole cakes and delivery.
